pull.title: KAFKA-21266: Compute the effective min ISR from the target partition
pull.body:
The controller used the replica count of partition 0 to compute the
effective min ISR for every partition of a topic. Partitions can have
different replication factors, so a small partition 0 could lower the
min ISR of other partitions and clear their ELR too early.

This patch uses the replicas of the partition being changed. All callers
already have that partition.

The test helper `newAlterPartition` always used partition index 0. It
now uses the given partition.

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

issue_comments.body:
Note: the same rule, `min(min.insync.replicas, replica count of the partition)`, is computed by the broker and the controller, and #24005 adds it to the CLI too.

This PR only adds a comment so the controller stays in sync with the broker. All three modules depend on `server-common`, so a follow-up could move the rule into one shared helper there. I can open a JIRA for it if that sounds reasonable.

commit.message:
KAFKA-21266: Compute the effective min ISR from the target partition

The controller used the replica count of partition 0 to compute the
effective min ISR for every partition of the topic. Partitions of one
topic can have different replication factors, so a small partition 0
could lower the min ISR of other partitions and clear their ELR too early.

Use the replicas of the partition being changed instead. All callers
already have that partition.

The test helper newAlterPartition always used partition index 0. It now
uses the given partition.

Generated-by: Claude Opus 5.5

KAFKA-21266: Add integration test for the effective min ISR

Partition 0 is reassigned to one replica, and partition 1 keeps four.
With min.insync.replicas=3, shutting down two replicas of partition 1
must put the second one in the ELR. Before the fix, the controller used
the replica count of partition 0 and cleared the ELR.

KAFKA-21266: Note that the effective min ISR must match the broker

Partition#effectiveMinIsr on the broker computes the same value. Say so
next to the controller code, so that the two stay in sync.
